decision.openInDecisions: This card needs the Decisions window.

composer.placeholder: Message the Manager, or type / for commands

join.title: Approve a new device?
join.body: A new device wants to read your chats. Only approve it if you just set it up yourself.
join.compare: Compare this fingerprint with the one shown on the other device. If they differ, reject.

revoke.effect: That device will stop receiving your chats and can never be trusted again.
revoke.cascade: Devices that were only introduced by it will also drop out and need to be approved again.

reset.title: Reset chat identity?
reset.body: This device becomes the only trusted device for your chats.
reset.newKeys: This device gets new chat keys.
reset.rejoin: Every other device must join again.

devices.title: Chat devices
devices.hint: Devices that can read your chats.
devices.keyMismatch: The relay now reports different keys for a device you trust. That device is not used until you check it.

panel.writeToAct: To make it act, write in its chat.
panel.pickSession: Select a session to see its details.
panel.auditHint: Every manager action is logged on this device.
panel.serverSeesBody: Encrypted blobs it cannot read, when messages are sent and their size, and which paired devices exchange them. It never sees message text or session names.
panel.providerSeesBody: The Manager is an AI agent. The provider that runs it does see the text the Manager processes, including session output it reads for you.

switchAgent.title: Switch agent
switchAgent.cliNote: {agent} sessions are managed from the tmgr CLI by design.
switchAgent.historyStays: Chat history stays. It lives in TMGR, not in the agent.
switchAgent.handoff: The new agent gets a handoff packet with the goal and a summary of the last messages.
